newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Flextech proposes loan stock, warrants.
newsitem.headline: Flextech proposes loan stock, warrants.

text.p: Electronics-based Flextech Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had proposed a renounceable rights issue of loan stock and warrants to raise about Singapore $21.5 million.
It said in a statement the issue comprised S$22 million in principal amount of loan stock with 26.4 million warrants.
Net proceeds from the issue will be used to finance the expansion of its facilities in Sinapore, including the purchase of equipment and machinery.
Proceeds will also be used for networking and communication projects, partial re-financing of bank borrowings and for working capital, it said.
The issue, which is lead managed by OCBC Bank, is subject to approvals from shareholders and the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
